field.name: com_tjucm_databreaches_Doestheschoolhaveabreachprocedureinplace
field.label: Does the school have a breach procedure in place?

field.name: com_tjucm_databreaches_Haveallstaffbeentrainedonhowtorecognisebreaches
field.label: Have all staff been trained on how to recognise breaches?

field.name: com_tjucm_databreaches_Hasthebreachactionplanbeencommunicatedtorelevantmembersofstaff
field.label: Has the breach action plan been communicated to relevant members of staff?
field.description: If the breach is serious, it may need reporting to the ICO within 72 hours of the school becoming aware. This includes across weekends, holidays and times the school is closed. Are staff aware of who may be needed to deal with a breach if it occurs?

field.name: com_tjucm_databreaches_Havetheschoolconductedatestbreach
field.label: Have the school conducted a test breach?
field.description: Creating a test breach scenario can identify areas of improvement and gaps in the procedure that can be identified before a real breach occurs

field.name: com_tjucm_databreaches_Arestaffawareofhowtologabreach
field.label: Are staff aware of how to log a breach?

field.label: Comments/Notes
field.hint: Type in notes for data breaches checklist
